evidence: The resistivity of TiN films was measured using a four-point probe. Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) was utilized to analyze the chemical composition and impurity content of the films. The growth rate was also determined based on film thickness per cycle from an AES depth profile. Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) was also utilized to evaluate the chemical composition, impurity content, and density of the films. The chemical structure of the films was also analyzed using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).
